doc: Case-study mapping sidecar (BUILD_PLAN I4). Frozen M0 law IR cannot gain the maps_to field, so this file maps each M0 law to the whitepaper §11 ids it bears on, and each checked hypothesis (results/M2/hypotheses.json) to the §11.6 obligation it discharges. M1 laws carry maps_to in their own IR. An empty list means the law is outside the §11 catalog; tools/casestudy.py lists such laws under laws_outside. Written at the I4 prereg, before the coverage table exists.

notes.L_par_hdr_ssvh: Not a §11 row. It surfaces a premise of D1: the Solidity commit path always writes sequencerSetVerifyHash = 0, so D1's 'Solidity ≡ Go except byte 0' holds only for ssvh = 0 (L_par_hdr_v0 and L_par_hdr_v1 carry that premise). Listed as outside the catalog rather than counted against or for D1.
notes.L_rt_go_v0: Go getters recover every field of the header Solidity commits: the decoding half of D1.
notes.L_rt_go_v2: As L_rt_go_v0, version 2 (D1 names v0/v1 layouts; v2 reuses the v1 wire format).
